topic: They are not more disciplined. They set something up.

slides.subtitle: (they set something up once)
slides.scene: Two work vans parked one behind the other on a quiet suburban street at dusk. Both vans have COMPLETELY BLANK side panels with absolutely no writing, no company name, no logo, no lettering, no phone number and no graphics of any kind anywhere on either vehicle. The near van is dark with its cab unlit. Warm light glows from the cab of the far van, and a single thin Scaile blue line rises from it and curves up out of the top of the frame. No signage anywhere in the scene, including on the houses behind.

caption:
You know the contractor in your area who posts every single day. Job photos, tips, before and afters, all of it.

The assumption is that they are more organised than you. Usually they are not. They set something up once and it has been running since.

That is worth sitting with, because it changes what the problem is. It is not that you need more willpower at the end of a twelve hour day. It is that you are doing by hand something that does not need a hand.

And the gap compounds. Not because any one post matters, but because when somebody finally goes looking for a contractor, one of you looks like a going concern and the other looks closed.

This account posts twice a day and I do not open the app. The whole setup is written up, free, including the bits that broke.

Comment AUTOMATE and I will send it.
